# hiok_stream_job (Resource)

A stream analytics job.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `admin_username` (String)
- `artifact_uri` (String) JAR/zip to run instead of SQL.
- `checkpoint_interval` (Number) Seconds between checkpoints.
- `engine` (String) risingwave, flink or spark.
- `engine_version` (String)
- `entry_class` (String) Main class of the artifact.
- `inputs` (String) Input streams (JSON).
- `network_mode` (String) public or vnet.
- `outputs` (String) Output sinks (JSON).
- `parallelism` (Number)
- `query_sql` (String) The job's SQL.
- `region` (String)
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `serving_engine` (String)
- `serving_version` (String)
- `sku` (String) dev, small, medium or large.
- `storage_gb` (Number)
- `subnet_name` (String)
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.
- `vnet_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
